addCompetingToken(address,address,addres.details: This function can only be called by the ILiquidityMigrator.

params.locker: The locker created for the liquidity position.
params.otherToken: The address of the other token in the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool for the token.
params.pool: The address of the Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool for the token.
params.token: The address of the token to add (must be a non-zero address).

checkUpkeep(bytes).details: This is the function that Chainlink nodes will call to check if the account is ready to reward the picked top tokens that bonded. This is measured with Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity TWGP (time weighed geometric mean price). Price = 1.0001 ^ T, where T is time weighted arithemetic mean tick, that is stored on a subgraph. The following is needed in order for upkeepNeeded to be true: 1. The reward resolver contract has picked a winner (in WAIING state) 2. Implicitly, the subscription has received LINK

returns.upkeepNeeded: - true if the reward resolver had picked winners

params.token: The address of the token to collect fees from its Aerodrome Concentrated Liquidity pool and burn

emitNewLockManagerAndNFT(address,address.details: This function can only be called by a burnable token, that has migrated and is part of the competing tokens.

params.lockNFT: The address of the lock NFT contract.

params.token: The isntance of the token address.

params._rewardResolver: The address of the RewardResolver contract.
params._swapRouter: The address of the Aerodrome Slipstream swap router contract.
params._treasury: The address of the treasury that will receive fees.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

performUpkeep(bytes).details: This is the function that Chainlink nodes will call to reward the picked top tokens that bonded. Each token's pool receives a portion of the total rewards. This is calculated as basePercent + additivePercent * multiplier. The multiplier is determined by the place in reverse order (if top 3 - 3th place has multiplier 1, 2nd place has multiplier 2, 1st place has multiplier 3).

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAdditivePercent(uint16).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._additivePercent: The additive percentage of the collected fees that goes to the top token/s.

setBasePercent(uint16).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._basePercent: The base percentage of the collected fees that goes to the top token/s.

setDevRewardPercent(uint16).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._devRewardPercent: The percentage of the collected fees that goes to the devs.

setDevRewardsCliff(uint256).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._devRewardsCliff: The number of days after which dev rewards can be claimed.

setLiquidityLocker(address).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract only once.

params._liquidityLocker: The address of the liquidity locker contract.

setLiquidityMigrator(address).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._liquidityMigrator: The address of the liquidity migrator contract.

setSlippage(uint16).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

setSwapRouter02(address).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._swapRouter: The address of theAerodrome Slipstream swap router contract.

setTreasury(address).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._treasury: The address of the treasury that will receive fees.

setTreasuryRewardPercent(uint16).details: This function can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params._treasuryRewardPercent: The percentage of the collected fees that goes to the treasury.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

addCompetingToken(address,address,addres.notice: Adds a competing token to the FeeAccount contract.

collectFeesAndDistribute(address).notice: Collects fees generated in the token's pool, distributes them among holders and dev, and rewards the caller. The reward in WETH is calculated as collectedWethAmount * collectRewardPercent / FEE_SCALE (scale of thousand).dev reward is not immediately transferred, but locked for a period of time (devRewardsCliff) in a lock position NFT. The lock NFT is transferred to the dev, so they can unclock the reward, once the lock expires. If the dev address is a contract, it must implement the IERC721Receiver interface to receive the lock NFT. Otherwise the reward will be distributed to the lock position NFT holders.

initialize(address,address,address).notice: Initializes the FeeAccount contract with the necessary parameters.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: Implemented to satisfy the IERC721Receiver interface, for the mint function of LockPositionsNFT (in collectFeesAndDistribute). Do not send NFTs to this contract directly, as it will not handle them properly.

setAdditivePercent(uint16).notice: Sets the additive percentage of the collected fees, that progressively adds to the base percentage of each of the top token/s (ASCENDING).It is in basis points (scale of thousand, e.g. 10 = 1%).

setBasePercent(uint16).notice: Sets the base percentage of the collected fees that goes to each of the top token/s, in basis points (scale of thousand, e.g. 50 = 5%).

setDevRewardPercent(uint16).notice: Sets the percentage of the collected fees that goes to the devs, in basis points (scale of thousand, e.g. 100 = 1%).

setDevRewardsCliff(uint256).notice: Sets the dev rewards (from the pool) cliff in days.

setLiquidityLocker(address).notice: Sets the liquidity locker contract address.

setLiquidityMigrator(address).notice: Sets the liquidity migrator contract address.

setSlippage(uint16).notice: Sets the slippage tolerance for swaps, in basis points (scale of thousand and acutal value is calculated as 1000 - value, e.g. value of 800 = 1000 - 800 = 200 => 20% slippage).

setSwapRouter02(address).notice: Sets the Aerodrome Slipstream swap router contract address.

setTreasury(address).notice: Sets the treasury address that will receive fees.

setTreasuryRewardPercent(uint16).notice: Sets the percentage of the collected fees that goes to the treasury, in basis points (scale of thousand, e.g. 10 = 1%).
